edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: adults with restless legs syndrome or low ferritin
edges.mechanism: Iron is required for dopamine handling in the brain, and deficiency may impair the very pathways most implicated in restless legs syndrome.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2026 Zhao meta analysis in Biomed Rep already points to iron deficiency tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
